entries.title: Assistants: your own companions
q: how do i get an assistant
how do i spawn an assistant
entries.answer: Assistants are your own helpers who follow, guard, gather and build. Craft and place an Assistant Spawner, then right-click it.
more: Assistants are your own companions, apart from the town's folk: they follow you, guard you, gather, mine, farm, build and stash loot, and can grow into a crew of up to ten with jobs.
Craft an Assistant Spawner (8 rotten flesh round a diamond), place it and right-click it: your assistant appears (or comes to it) and the block becomes its home.
steps: Right-click the assistant (as its owner) for its pack and gear, with Stop, Follow, Stay, Guard, Deposit and Come.
Look at it and press R for its full orders.
tips: Only the owner can command an assistant or open its pack.
It's mortal: feed it, armour it, and it retreats from fights it would lose.

entries.title: An assistant's orders (R)
q: how do i give my assistant orders
entries.answer: Look at one of your assistants and press R for all its orders on one page.
more: Look at one of your assistants and press R for its orders on one page, in groups: Job, Ground (its patch: show it), Orders (Follow, Stay, Come, Stop, Stash...), Duty (how deep to dig: surface to diamond), plus Pack, Record, Name (pick a name from a page, no typing), Quiet/Chatty, and Plot Book ›.
controls: Orders → Pack · Record · Name · Plot Book ›
tips: No assistant in sight? R picks the nearest one.
G gives a whole-crew readout without walking to a Job Board.

entries.title: The crew list, map and totals
q: how many assistants can i have
entries.answer: Press ; for the list of your own assistants, with Map, Totals and the block book a click away.
more: Press ; for the crew list: every assistant by level, name, job and duty with a live status light; pick one and order it about.
Map shows every patch you've marked and who's on it; Totals sums everything the crew has produced with a per-day rate; Blocks opens the block book (what every block is for, with its recipe).
tips: A crew holds up to ten: miners, lumberjacks, farmers, builders.
The list holds only your own assistants; with none, the crew's order buttons are switched off.

entries.title: The plot book (B) and Work Zone Marker
q: assign an assistant to a field
mark a farm for my crew
entries.answer: Press B for the plot book: the ground you've staked and the crew working it. Stake new ground with Stake Here.
more: Pick a plot on the left, click hands on the right; Stake Here, Name ›, Trade ›, Shift ›, Copy, Stamp, Forget, Undo.
Or use the Work Zone Marker: right-click two blocks to stake a plot's corners, then right-click an assistant to put it on the plot.
controls: [Right-click] two blocks with the Work Zone Marker → [Right-click] an assistant
tips: Work Zone Marker recipe: redstone over two sticks.

entries.title: Place Marker
entries.answer: Right-click a block with a Place Marker to make that spot your nearest assistant's home.
more: Craft it from paper over a stick.

entries.title: Job Board (your crew's hub)
entries.answer: Place a Job Board and right-click it to set your assistants' role mix: Auto, Mining, Balanced, Food or Build.
more: It becomes your crew's centre: every autonomous assistant within 64 blocks takes a role round it, and on Auto they balance to whatever the depot chest beside it is short of.
Craft it from 8 oak planks round a book.
warn: It's for your assistants, not the town's folk: the folk's jobs board is on the U page.

entries.title: Memory Core (bringing a companion back)
entries.answer: A fallen assistant drops a Memory Core: right-click the ground with it to bring that same assistant back.
more: When a companion falls it drops a Memory Core holding everything it was.
It has no recipe and can't be bought.
controls: [Right-click] the ground with the Memory Core
tips: Its gear stays where it fell: go back for it. The core is fireproof and slow to despawn.
